name: Lifeboat
feature_notes: Lifeboat restores Captain backup access when a startup migration fails. Backup controls bind before migrations, report progress independently, fail visibly on unreadable primary orders, and time out safely. Export remains orders and settings only. No cleanup, migration retry or backend change. See LIFEBOAT_GUIDE.md.

backend_prerequisite.reason: Countercraft tables, private storage and exact-vessel gateway verified. TrueFit service v2 deployed; Sea Trial remains enabled only by owner publication.
